capabilities: Search PubMed and add papers as Markdown notes with CSL-JSON frontmatter
Import libraries from BibTeX, RIS, nbib, CSL-JSON, or a running Zotero 7
Generate LLM section summaries and MeSH topic tags for each reference
Insert [@citekey] via @ autocomplete and build CSL-style bibliographies and .docx manuscripts
Chat with and semantically search the library, with citation graphs and retraction checks
extras: Desktop-only as of 0.6.0 (mobile unsupported). Requires a contact e-mail in settings for OpenAlex, Unpaywall, and PubMed lookups. Hosted cross-encoder reranker costs about $0.0002 per search. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: a Zotero / EndNote replacement inside Obsidian
problem: Obsidian has no built-in reference manager, so researchers must run Zotero or EndNote alongside their vault to collect papers and cite while writing.

relations.evidence: a Zotero / EndNote replacement inside Obsidian
straight from a running Zotero 7 (whole library or one collection)
It uses this plugin's MCP server as its reference library
let an external AI search the live library, find, add, and summarize papers
runs Pandoc with the bundled academic template

requires.name: OpenRouter/OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic key for chat, summaries, and embeddings
Codex CLI / OpenCode CLI as keyless LLM providers; Pandoc for .docx export; Zotero 7 for import; Claude Code/Codex for MCP

summary: Citation manager that keeps references as Markdown notes: PubMed search, AI summaries, MeSH tags, CSL bibliographies, and chat with your library.
